stage0200_02:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Good work, $n.
　The simulator session is complete.」

stage0200_02:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Destruction rate: 72.3 percent.
　Not a bad score.」

stage0200_02:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ルカ$$
「You have not been fighting for long, yet
　few people could score this well.」

stage0200_02:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$n
「...I appreciate the encouragement, but
　give me your honest assessment.
　For example, how do I compare with the others...?」

stage0200_02:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「...$$アルト$$, one week after joining $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$,
　would have scored over 98 percent
　on a simulator at this difficulty level.」

stage0200_02:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That guy is a kind of genius.
　There is no point comparing yourself to him.」

stage0200_02:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Just keep moving forward in your own way.」

stage0200_02:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$n
「...I'll run the simulation a little longer.」

stage0200_02:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Got it.
　But there is no way we can keep up with you,
　so I'll set it to auto.」

stage0200_02:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Rest is important too, $n.
　Push yourself too hard and it will affect
　your condition.」

stage0200_02:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「See you.
　Top 95 percent and I'll move you up a grade.」

stage0200_02:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$n
「...I have no choice but to do this...」

stage0200_02:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「...Why aren't you using my last name?」

stage0200_02:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$スズネ$$
「At school, I'll call you $l.
　Even if we're partners who face life and death,
　we must keep our public and private lives separate.」

stage0200_02:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「One more thing... Can I ask you something?」

stage0200_02:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You regularly post on the $$オカルトフォーラム$$ about
　'a survivor of a $$時空震動$$'...
　Is it tied to your father and sister's accident?」

stage0200_02:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
「Well... I'm going to run simulations now...」

stage0200_02:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$n
「This is for one person.
　For help with the $$ジェニオン$$'s navigation,
　please ask $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0200_02:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Today is softball practice.
　$$さやか$$ joined provisionally and is fielding balls,
　while $$クラン$$ is sticking close as a coach.」

stage0200_02:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「For all her complaints,
　$$クラン$$ seems to enjoy life as a high school girl.」

stage0200_02:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「You know him.
　He's guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$ from somewhere.」

stage0200_02:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「If anything happens, the commotion he makes
　will tell us whether we like it or not.」

stage0200_02:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ボス$$
「You're overdoing it!
　At this rate you'll wear out before we sortie!」

stage0200_02:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$甲児$$
「Being dedicated is fine,
　but if you don't unwind, you'll burn out.」

stage0200_02:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Take a break once in a while.
　Leave guarding the target to $$宗介$$,
　and let's go get some ramen.」

stage0200_02:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アルト$$
「Come to think of it, I heard a 'Nyan Nyan' branch
　is in this city too.」

stage0200_02:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アルト$$
「It's a famous Chinese place in the Frontier fleet.
　Their Galaxy Ramen is superb.」

stage0200_02:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$甲児$$
「All right, settled!
　We'll eat that while we hold
　our strategy meeting.」

stage0200_02:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アルト$$
「We're not going out to have fun.
　This is a strategy meeting.」

stage0200_02:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Speaking of breaks, what about the upcoming hike...?」

stage0200_02:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アルト$$
「A joint recreational event for the local schools...
　Just what you'd expect in a research campus city.」

stage0200_02:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「So we'll meet $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ there too.」

stage0200_02:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アルト$$
「Then leave guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$
　to $$宗介$$, $$正太郎$$, and the others.」

stage0200_02:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アルト$$
「Meanwhile, we'll remain here
　as the Academy Defense Force.」

stage0200_02:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So you're just skipping because it's a drag?」

stage0200_02:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I agree.
　Hiking in the mountains isn't my thing.」

stage0200_02:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ will lecture us if she finds out.」

stage0200_02:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ボス$$
「But... at our age,
　we can't be going on a hike.
　Right, $n?」

stage0200_02:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Never saw that answer coming...!」

stage0200_02:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ボス$$
「What's with you, $n!
　Are you really that scared of Miss $$スズネ$$?!」

stage0200_02:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$n
「Like you said, I need a break too, don't I?」

stage0200_02:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ボス$$
「I just can't picture you hiking
　through all that greenery.」

stage0200_02:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's how it is, $$アルト$$.
　If $n is going and we don't,
　we'll have no excuse for Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0200_02:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Guess we have no choice.
　But if we're going, let's make it a fun hike.」

stage0200_02:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$n
「Who knows...
　As long as that guy is there, I smell trouble...」

stage0200_02:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$n
「Yeah...
　Meanwhile, we can carry out our own mission.」

stage0200_02:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「You handle our excuse to Miss $$スズネ$$, $n.」

stage0200_02:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$甲児$$
「Of course.
　You two are partners, after all.」

stage0200_02:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アルト$$
「We'll let $$宗介$$ and the others handle the hike.」

stage0200_02:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Over there, though,
　I smell trouble as long as $$宗介$$'s around.」

stage0200_02:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
（I wonder if Chidori will call me again...）

stage0200_02:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well. It seems $n and the others
　have decided to go hiking...」

stage0200_02:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But was that choice truly the right one?」

stage0200_02:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just thought I'd stir up a little doubt.
　Now, let's get to it... business, business!」

stage0200_02:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, it seems $n and the others
　have decided to skip the hike...」

stage0200_02:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But was that choice truly the right one?」

stage0200_02:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just thought I'd stir up a little doubt.
　Now, let's get to it... business, business!」
